facts.fact: BusinessDay reports the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, led by national commissioner and chief executive Vincent Olatunji, ran a three-day data protection training with Meta for about 380 public officers in Abuja on 27-29 October 2026.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is acting, with national commissioner Vincent Olatunji opening its 27-29 October 2026 compliance training for public officers.
The NDPC and Meta trained about 380 public officers, including 80 data protection officers certified with NDPC continuing professional development points, in Abuja on 27-29 October 2026.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is led by national commissioner and chief executive Vincent Olatunji, who opened its public-sector training on 27 October 2026.

The NDPC ran a three-day compliance training for about 380 public officers, including 80 data protection officers, covering records of processing, lawful bases, breach detection and incident management, and plans further sessions.
